verdict.rationale: Zamzar's own API docs claim support for hundreds of formats, including documents and eBooks, across over 1,100 conversions, which plausibly covers EPUB and DOCX. No evidence names Markdown, HTML, LaTeX, EPUB or DOCX conversions specifically, so coverage of this story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Markdown, HTML, LaTeX, EPUB and DOCX as source and target formats, a conversion matrix between them, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, markup and e-book formats (Markdown, HTML, LaTeX, EPUB, DOCX) convert between each other

citations.quote: We support 100's of different file formats including documents, videos, images, audio, CAD, eBooks and more.
Use the API to perform over 1,100 different conversions.
